_comment: 8d Phase B canonical (8d C1, issue #14, extended in place): teleport-based walkthrough of the two new dungeon maps (dungeon_approach, trapped_halls) -- neither is reachable from any EXISTING live map without the quest state C1 landed (B3's gallery door_when gates on `horns_delve_started`, absent from this fixture), so this script stays the sole proof they render/work independent of the quest, matching street_peek/floodplains_peek's own teleport-only precedent, a real CANONICAL (assert-verified). Loads cisterns_scout_start (warrior L1 + [Tactician]/[Appraise Foe] already known) via title Continue, then teleports in. dungeon_approach now carries 6 entities (the original 3 plus Ceria/Yvlon/Ksmvr, C1's own dungeon_approach NPC trio -- untouched by this route, which never approaches row 5). trapped_halls carried 8 at C1 (the original 6 plus `ksmvr_plates`/`seal_kept_door`, both off this route's own cells; 9 since the #91 shift disclosed below). All 4 trap classes probed as before, with C1's real gates now live and correctly UNMET at this fixture's own state: dart_slit_a's skill-known nudge still fires, but the hotbar disarm now refuses via the NEW `requires_item: trap_kit` gate (this fixture carries no trap_kit -- `delve_skill` is where the real consume lives); snare_nest_slot and vault_boss_slot are now REAL `kind:encounter` entities gated by `encounter_when` (`horns_delve_started`/`halls_cleared` respectively, both unmet here) -- their plain interacts now read the gate-closed fallback (`gate_closed_toast`, copy held verbatim from each entity's own pre-promotion flavor line) instead of banking a flavor accomplishment. Whole-run negative: combat_started never fires (every gate stays unmet at this fixture's own state). ISSUE #91 (hour-4 spine) SHIFT, DISCLOSED: trapped_halls gained a 9th entity, `gallery_vermin_nest` (12,11) -- off every cell this route's own walked path touches (rows 5-9 only, traced against the exact move sequence below), so the walk itself is byte-identical; only the ui_entities_rendered sprite-count assertion below moved 9->10 (entity count + the PC's own sprite).

steps._comment: == ENTER dungeon_approach via teleport (unreachable any other way this phase) ==
== bounds lap: the full perimeter is clear (no obstacle sits on the border) -- right 15, down 11, left 15, up 11 returns to (0,0) with zero blocked bumps.
== the gallery-seal anchor (1,6) -- the B3 landing cell, currently an inert rubble-choked flavor prop.

payload_contains.text: The stone doesn't budge. Whatever's on the other side stays sealed. For now.

steps._comment: == the dormant guardian foreshadow (8,9) -- the ratified boss pick's vault_construct sprite, dimmed and still.

payload_contains.text: You keep your distance. Whatever wakes it, you would rather not be the one who finds out.

steps._comment: == the REAL new door: dungeon_approach -> trapped_halls (a brand-new pairing between these two brand-new maps, NOT the excluded gallery-door edit).

2026-07-26 Act V SHIFT, DISCLOSED: 12 -> 13. trapped_halls gained `seal_warden_alcove` (19,6), an ENCOUNTER -- present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters, so it stands visible and inert from first arrival (rift_vermin_leak's own pattern) and counts here even at this fixture's zero-progress state. Its encounter_when (seal_opened) is unmet, and its trigger_radius is consulted only through that same gate, so this route neither arms nor triggers it; the walk below is byte-identical. Act V's OTHER new entity, `pisces_seal_escort` (19,8), is present_when-gated on seal_descent_agreed and correctly absent here -- which is why the count moved by one, not two.
== TRAP CLASS 1: pressure plate (6,7) -- a real [Appraise Foe] reveal, then a plain interact TRIGGER.

payload_contains.text: One flagstone sits a hair proud of its neighbors, the mortar cracked clean around its edge. Stepping square on it feels like a very bad idea.
The flagstone gives half an inch under your hand. Somewhere close, something CLICKS. Nothing else happens. This time.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 2: dart slit (10,5) -- disarm-only shape. A plain interact with the skill KNOWN reads the 2026-07-10 nudge (never auto-disarms). 8d C1 (issue #14): the hotbar disarm now ALSO gates on carrying `trap_kit` (this fixture carries none -- `delve_skill` proves the real consume) -- the field hotbar attempt refuses via the item_hint_toast, never reaching skill_used/the accomplishment bank.

payload_contains.text: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. This wants a careful, deliberate touch, not a shove.
A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. Bare hands won't do it — you'd want a proper kit for this.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 3: illusory floor (14,7) -- 'floor that isn't', zero new sim (entity occupancy alone blocks movement). A literal walk-into-it proves the bump, then the same nudge-then-hotbar-reveal sequence.

payload_contains.text: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. Somehow, that is the part that bothers you.
You look again, and this time you see it: the grain runs the wrong way, and no dust has settled in months. That is not floor. That is a very good painting of floor.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 4: snare (17,8) -- PROMOTED to a live encounter (8d C1), `encounter_when` gated on `horns_delve_started` (unmet here). A plain interact now reads the gate-closed fallback -- no accomplishment banked (the old flavor id `spotted_the_snare_nest` retired with the kind swap), just `gate_closed_toast` (copy held verbatim from the pre-promotion flavor line).

payload_contains.text: You give the wire a wide berth. Something in the dark past it has not noticed you yet.

steps._comment: == THE VAULT (18,6) -- 8d C1: PROMOTED to a live encounter, `encounter_when` gated on `halls_cleared` AND `horns_party_formed` (both unmet here -- the party leg is the solo-lockout, so a party-less interact can never field the fight). Detours around snare_nest_slot's own occupied cell (17,8) via row 6, then returns to the (16,8) waypoint the pre-existing exit sequence below already expects. Gate-closed fallback: no accomplishment banked (the old flavor id `found_the_vault` retired with the kind swap), just `gate_closed_toast` (the halls+Horns signpost line).

payload_contains.text: Whatever waits beyond this arch, you are not walking into it yet — not with the halls still armed, not without the Horns at your back.

steps._comment: == EXIT via the real return door (1,7), landing back at dungeon_approach (13,6) -- one cell west of the outbound door's own (14,6) cell.
Scope guard: none of the three dormant slots (dormant_guardian_marker/snare_nest_slot/vault_boss_slot) carries a LIVE combat trigger yet -- whole-run negative proof, C1's own job to arm the gate.
